subject: SCP-017
text: SCP-017 is a child-sized shadow creature that engulfs anyone whose shadow falls across it.
author: Sam Swicegood (CityToast)

subject: SCP-020
text: SCP-020 is a mold that hides from human perception, leaving cameras to reveal the infestation its hosts cannot see.
author: Aelanna

subject: SCP-021
text: SCP-021 is a living dragon tattoo that moves across its host's skin and consumes the skin it inhabits.
author: HK-016

subject: SCP-023
text: SCP-023 resembles a black dog with burning eyes; meeting its gaze carries a consequence that may take a year to arrive.
author: Pig_catapult

subject: SCP-027
text: SCP-027 turns a human host into a gathering place for vermin, attracting creatures that never seem to stop coming.
author: Quikngruvn

subject: SCP-030
text: SCP-030 is a small, grey, hairless humanoid: the Foundation's version of an alchemist's homunculus.
author: Mulciber

subject: SCP-031
text: SCP-031 is an amorphous creature that persuades people it is someone they once loved, borrowing affection along with an identity.
author: Anonymous, rewritten by DrClef

subject: SCP-039
text: SCP-039 is a group of altered proboscis monkeys whose missing facial features do not prevent their remarkable mechanical skills.
author: Anonymous and Wilt, rewritten by Kothardarastrix

subject: SCP-040
text: SCP-040 is a child who can reshape living organisms, treating biology as something that can be edited.
author: Kain Pathos Crow, rewritten by Djoric

subject: SCP-042
text: SCP-042 resembles a horse with the remains of wings: a creature that seems to remember a sky it can no longer reach.
author: Unknown Author, rewritten by Skali Sharpnose

subject: SCP-049
text: SCP-049 looks like a plague doctor and insists it can cure a pestilence; its patients rarely survive the treatment.
author: Gabriel Jade, rewritten by djkaktus & Gabriel Jade

subject: SCP-053
text: SCP-053 looks like a small girl, but prolonged contact makes adults turn violently against those around them.
author: Dr Gears

subject: SCP-054
text: SCP-054 is a water-based being that usually takes a human form, giving a nymph a place in the containment records.
author: Unknown Author, rewritten by SimpleCadence

subject: SCP-056
text: SCP-056 changes its appearance to surpass the people around it: admiration becomes a surprisingly difficult thing to contain.
author: Unknown author

subject: SCP-058
text: SCP-058 resembles a walking heart armed with barbed tentacles, and speaks even when nothing about it resembles a mouth.
author: Unknown author

subject: SCP-060
text: SCP-060 is a grove of oaks whose burning wood can summon an extremely hostile, burning skeleton.
author: Dexanote

subject: SCP-068
text: SCP-068 is a tiny wire figure that can use nearby metal to make more figures like itself.
author: Dr Wacey

subject: SCP-069
text: SCP-069 assumes the appearance and identity of a recently dead person, leaving an unsettlingly convincing replacement.
author: Aelanna

subject: SCP-073
text: SCP-073 calls itself Cain; injuries directed at it return to the attacker, while nearby plant life fares badly.
author: Kain Pathos Crow

subject: SCP-075
text: SCP-075 resembles a snail with a clawed hand for a foot; its small size conceals an extraordinary weight.
author: Unknown author, rewritten by Aelanna

subject: SCP-076
text: SCP-076 contains a warrior who returns after death: defeating him and keeping him defeated are different problems.
author: Kain Pathos Crow, rewritten by DrClef

subject: SCP-082
text: SCP-082 is a giant with cultivated manners and a taste for human flesh: hospitality is not the same as safety.
author: FritzWillie

subject: SCP-085
text: SCP-085 is a living drawing called Cassy, able to move across connected sheets while remaining entirely two-dimensional.
author: FritzWillie

subject: SCP-088
text: SCP-088 is a mummified reptilian humanoid whose dormant appearance makes a poor promise that it will stay that way.
author: Sorts

subject: SCP-096
text: SCP-096 is usually docile until someone sees its face; even a photograph can turn a distant glimpse into a pursuit.
author: Dr Dan

subject: SCP-106
text: SCP-106 resembles a decaying old man, corrodes what it touches and takes victims into a pocket dimension.
author: Dr Gears

subject: SCP-111
text: SCP-111 consists of tiny, snail-like dragons: a reminder that fire-breathing creatures do not have to be enormous.
author: Adam Henderson

subject: SCP-173
text: SCP-173 is a sculpture that moves when nobody is watching; a blink can be enough to lose the distance between you.
author: Moto42

subject: SCP-682
text: SCP-682 is a reptilian creature that adapts to attempts to destroy it, turning containment into an argument it keeps surviving.
author: Dr Gears and Epic Phail Spy

subject: SCP-999
text: SCP-999 is a friendly orange gelatinous creature whose touch brings intense happiness: not every anomaly is a nightmare.
author: ProfSnider
